scientific_notes_separate_from_fidelity.pixel_verdict: CONFIRMED -10, not -19, from the sole SOURCE299 view before canonical.
scientific_notes_separate_from_fidelity.scientific_verdict: Printed scientific error in calling this a green-light photon energy.
scientific_notes_separate_from_fidelity.derivation: Using the frozen page-298 h=6.62e-34 J s and E=h nu gives nu=6.0423e23 Hz. With the explicit approximate physical constant c=3e8 m/s, lambda=hc/E=4.965e-16 m, not a visible/green wavelength. If the exponent were -19, lambda would be 4.965e-7 m (496.5 nm). This is separate arithmetic inference, never the basis for reading the final printed superscript.
